notes.title: Bloom, Hunger, and Goblins
notes.content:
Update v0.05.04 is here!
[list]
[*]added Bloom visual effect
[*]put back Hunger (as earlier, you must find food to survive)
[*]added a new mob (green jumping Goblins)
[*]other minor fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32292159/2c14e7ea8908d1450761fbc4571eeef9f3c19c3e.png[/img]

notes.title: Stone Construction Update (v0.05.02)
notes.content:
Now you can build from plane stones!
Also, Mallet was put into Quick Craft
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32292159/0e58e4c7c2e0c36f9d37d5be7cf6b142c8d25880.png[/img]

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Finally, long awaited update (v0.05.01) is here!

[list]
[*]Fixed the white screen bug and 33 smaller bugs
[*]Made movement, crafting, and building much easier
[*]Added new entities
[*]Game is now paid, and the price will raise along with new updates
[/list]
